name: Feature assistant
author: Brett
description: Plain-English features for the Feature Planner: describe a feature in your own words, the AXF expert drafts proper plan entries (sub-features, dependencies, ports, model) and flags clashes; you edit and approve; they go to the plan and the pending list. Build with Mosses on any unbuilt feature: confirm, plan, new build order, model choice (Opus now, Fable later), then Mosses builds it in the assistant chat with approval cards and snapshots. Settings → Plugins → Feature assistant.
